products.title: Bijur Delimon AV, AVE and AVH Air-Oil Injector Blocks
products.descriptionShort: Bijur Delimon AV, AVE and AVH Air-Oil Injector Blocks: 20 part numbers, for PDI systems; oil. AV, AVE and AVH blocks mix a measured shot of oil into a controlled air stream for air-oil lubrication of high-speed spindles and bearings, with one to eight positive-displacement injectors (PDI) per block. From Indus Hydraulics, authorised Bijur Delimon distributor for the Middle East, supplied direct from the manufacturer.
products.descriptionLong:
AV, AVE and AVH blocks mix a measured shot of oil into a controlled air stream for air-oil lubrication of high-speed spindles and bearings, with one to eight positive-displacement injectors (PDI) per block.

Indus Hydraulics is an authorised Bijur Delimon distributor for the Middle East and supplies genuine units direct from the manufacturer, with the maker's datasheets and manuals.

How it works

Each outlet has its own air needle valve. On every pressure-and-relief cycle of the lubricator each injector fires its shot into the air line, and the air carries the oil along the tube wall to the bearing as one continuous streak. Injectors come in seven outputs; for ceramic and steel high-speed bearings the 0.01 and 0.025 cc/cycle sizes are the usual choice. The blocks are built to order code; replacement ZCN injectors and plugs are listed by part number.

Range

20 listed part numbers plus versions configured to order from 42,070 order codes (AV…, AVE…, AVH…) — systems PDI; lubricants Oil; output 0.01 to 0.4 cc. The size table gives each part number's data.

Row descriptions are Bijur Delimon's own: LS / LLS level or low-level switch, HLS high-level switch, PG pressure gauge, PS pressure switch, CNTL controller, P&M pump and motor, SLR single-line resistance, PDI positive-displacement injector, PROG progressive. The columns give each part number's published data.

Where it is used

  • high-speed machine-tool spindles
  • rolling-mill and wire-mill bearings
  • small-pitch chains, cam followers and linear bearings

Choosing an air-oil system

Air-oil suits high-speed bearings and spindles that need a small, continuous oil feed with cooling air — far less oil than an oil bath or oil mist, and no mist in the workshop. Start from the number of points, the oil grade and the shot each point needs (0.01 to 0.30 cc per cycle), then the air supply: it must be clean and dry, so plan a filter-regulator. Add an oil streak sensor where a lost feed would mean a bearing failure.

Complete systems

These components are one part of a lubrication system. We supply the Bijur Delimon lubricators, distribution, tubing, fittings, controllers and monitoring to match, sized to the number of points and the lubricant. Send us the machine and the lubrication points and we propose the full system.

The oil streak generating unit is a complete, pre-assembled air-oil lubrication system for high-speed spindles and other points that need a small, continuous oil feed carried by air. products.descriptionLong:
The oil streak generating unit is a complete, pre-assembled air-oil lubrication system for high-speed spindles and other points that need a small, continuous oil feed carried by air.

Indus Hydraulics is an authorised Bijur Delimon distributor for the Middle East and supplies genuine units direct from the manufacturer, with the maker's datasheets and manuals.

How it works

It combines a SureFire II gear-pump lubricator, an electronic controller that runs and monitors the system, air treatment (5-micron filter and 0.01-micron coalescing filter), an on-off air solenoid and an air-oil mixing manifold. Oil is injected into the air stream every one to five minutes, so the bearing receives a continuous film; spindles above DN 500,000 benefit most. Tubing, nozzles, gauges, filters and switches for the unit are listed here too.

Range

17 listed part numbers plus versions configured to order from 252 order codes (OP…) — systems SLR / PDI, PDI; lubricants Oil; maximum pressure 500 psi (34 bar). The size table gives each part number's data.

Row descriptions are Bijur Delimon's own: LS / LLS level or low-level switch, HLS high-level switch, PG pressure gauge, PS pressure switch, CNTL controller, P&M pump and motor, SLR single-line resistance, PDI positive-displacement injector, PROG progressive. The columns give each part number's published data.

Where it is used

  • high-speed spindles (DN > 500,000)
  • small-pitch chains and cam followers
  • linear bearings under contamination

Choosing an air-oil system

Air-oil suits high-speed bearings and spindles that need a small, continuous oil feed with cooling air — far less oil than an oil bath or oil mist, and no mist in the workshop. Start from the number of points, the oil grade and the shot each point needs (0.01 to 0.30 cc per cycle), then the air supply: it must be clean and dry, so plan a filter-regulator. Add an oil streak sensor where a lost feed would mean a bearing failure.

faqs.question: What is an SLR system?
faqs.answer: Single-line resistance: the pump pushes oil into one line and meter units — calibrated restrictors at each point — share it out by their flow rating. Simple and low-pressure, for oil on machine tools and light machinery.

faqs.question: What is a PDI system?
faqs.answer: Positive-displacement injector: every injector holds a measured shot and fires it when the pump pressurises the line; the pump then vents the line so the injectors refill. Each point gets a fixed volume regardless of back-pressure, with oil or fluid grease.

A spring behind the piston feeds grease steadily to one bearing.   • fans, conveyors and pumps

Collection tubes at each leak point run to a small central reservoir under air-powered vacuum.
